Stats: coachless.gg, patches 16.17 to 16.20 added together, pulled 2026-10-22.
Rune numbers: LoL wiki (ranged values).
Coachless has no Challenger-only bracket; Master+ is its top.

Precision · Each attack on a champion: +4.8% attack speed for
6s, up to 6 stacks (28.8%). At 6 stacks attacks add 6 to 21.7
adaptive damage, +1% per 1% bonus attack speed.

Precision · 3 attacks on one champion within 4s: 40 to 174
adaptive damage, then +8% damage to champions until 5s after
leaving combat.

Sorcery · Deal 25% of a champion's max health within 3s: +36%
move speed and 50% slow resist for 4s. 20 to 8.8s cooldown.

Sorcery · Ability damage to a champion drops a comet: 15 to
110 (+10% bonus AD, +5% AP), doubled at max travel distance.

Inspiration · Hit a champion first: 3s of 7% bonus true damage
to champions, and 35% of that bonus damage back as gold. 25 to
15s cooldown; lost if they hit you first.

Bar = all patches added together. Whisker = rough 95% noise from
sample size alone (cut off at the axis ends). Small sepia ticks =
single patches. Grey = under 1,000 games, too few to read.
No WPA in any bracket: Fleet Footwork, Conqueror, Summon Aery,
Deathfire Touch, Glacial Augment, Unsealed Spellbook, Electrocute,
Dark Harvest, Hail of Blades, Grasp of the Undying, Aftershock,
Guardian.

WPA = win rate − how likely those players were to win
anyway (after draft). Positive means the pick added
win chance on average.

• NA Gold+ (61,207 games): Lethal Tempo −0.08 is the
safe default. Press the Attack trails it by 1.2 pp,
about 1.8× the noise.
• The one lead worth testing: in NA Diamond+
Stormraider's (+1.74) beats Lethal Tempo (−2.38) by
2.4× the noise, and Master+ points the same way
(2.2×). Stormraider's has only 980 NA Diamond+ games,
so its bar stays grey.
• Why only a lead: I compared many pairs, so one of
them can look strong by chance. And worldwide,
Stormraider's fell from +4.63 on 16.17 to +0.14 on
16.20, so adding patches up may hide a change.
• Next: try Stormraider's in your own NA games and
re-check here each patch.

• A keystone comes with a secondary tree and a build.
WPA credits the whole setup, not the rune alone.
• Coachless's rank filter goes Gold, Platinum,
Emerald, Diamond, Master+. There is no Challenger-only
bracket and nothing below Gold, so 'all ranks' here
means Gold+.
• Each patch was pulled on its own (the free site
allows one patch at a time). The page adds them up:
games are summed and WPA is the game-weighted average,
which is exact because WPA is itself an average over
games. Pooling mixes any balance changes between
patches.

Stats:
https://coachless.gg/runes/tree/kogmaw/precision/resolve?role=adc
vs all champions, 'Hide low occurrence' on (site default). Rank
and region set in the Filters panel; they don't show in the URL.
Keystone pick counts are across all secondary trees. The runes
page shows WPA and picks only, no win rate.
